study type: Study of nulliparous, term, singleton, vertex deliveries with maternal-neonatal dyad data
outcome: cardiopulmonary resuscitation or ventilator use (within 24 h)
cohort: The study included 77,058 maternal-neonatal dyads from the MarketScan Research Database (2015-2017).
finding: Severe perinatal morbidity was associated with increasing individual physician cesarean delivery rates.
